meta.title: Nell Ashdown — a printmaker on Mētis
meta.description: A printmaker, illustrator and teacher on the new Mētis theme in its warm Aeaea style: a wall of pictures and coloured tiles up top, her three trades as three big words, prints for sale as cards and the next workshops as a ruled list.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
